verdict.rationale: Unleash's own change requests add a required approval step before any change in an environment, with up to 10 approvals. That covers the 'review' part for configuration changes, which would include automated rollout setups such as release templates and milestone progression. Nothing in the evidence documents version history for these automations or a way to roll back an automation's configuration; the safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments roll back a feature release, not the automation itself. missing for 10: versioning/history of automation configs, rollback of automation definitions, explicit documentation that change requests cover release plans/templates, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
